options.content:
## Browser Speech (Web Speech API)

**Browser Speech** uses the browser's built-in `speechSynthesis` API. Audio is generated **on the student's device**, fully offline, with no server call, so there is no server span and no server log.

`js/looma-utilities.js` reports each press, and `looma-telemetry.php` turns it into a span **`tts.synthesis`** (service `looma-web-rum`), timed from pressing Speak to the utterance's `start` event. The panel beside this one lists those spans. On the OpenSearch service map the engine is the node `looma-browser-speech`.

If the browser has no voice for the language, Piper reads instead, and that press counts on the Piper dashboard.

Pick Browser Speech as the default engine, or test it, on the **Speech Test** page.

panels.title: Recent Browser Speech presses
panels.description: Each press as a span, since this engine runs in the browser and writes no server logs.
